subject: Fraud & Scams
title: Sam Bankman-Fried and FTX
description: One-minute skill: Sam Bankman-Fried and FTX.

hook.text: FTX's founder was worth $26 billion. Within a week, his exchange collapsed and customer funds vanished.

buildup.text: Sam Bankman-Fried ran FTX and secretly funneled customer deposits to his hedge fund Alameda Research.

discovery.text: A leaked balance sheet showed Alameda's assets were mostly FTX's own token — not real money.

twist.text: He positioned himself as crypto's responsible face, lobbying Congress while stealing customer funds.

climax.text: He was convicted on seven counts of fraud and sentenced to 25 years in prison.

punchline.text: The face of responsible crypto ran the biggest crypto fraud.

quiz.question: Where did SBF secretly send FTX customer deposits?
options: To his hedge fund Alameda Research
